name: Wisprs
description: Official hosted Wisprs server. Transcribes audio, video and public media links (YouTube, podcasts, direct files) in 100+ languages, then searches the user's transcript library, summarizes, generates chapters, translates and repurposes transcripts, and exports TXT, SRT, VTT, JSON, Markdown or DOCX. OAuth 2.1 sign-in; free plan available.
author: Wisprs
